regions.name: Miami-Dade County
regions.model_scope: Miami-Dade County independent 2024–25 grade-school district models: exact operational CCD LEA 1200390 / native FL-13 attachments, complete reported pure lower offerings including grade 3–8, and explicit-zero native enrolled grades 9–12. Exact attached charters, alternatives and special-education profiles are retained; native missing outcomes determine eligibility. Separate same-year native Florida School Grades Math, ELA and Combined point-only OLS models. High and mixed offerings are excluded.
